D: Riggs and Murtaugh take on a Triad gang smuggling people into LA.
P: Serve the Chinese food when Uncle Benny turns up.
S: Pork and prawn siu mai: pork mince, chopped prawn, shiitake, ginger and soy in open wonton wrappers, steamed 8 minutes, a dot of carrot on top.
the fishing trip that goes wrong in the opening
Smoked fish dip: hot-smoked trout flaked into cream cheese with lemon, dill and horseradish, served with crackers.
Leo's back, and he will not stop talking
Wonton wrappers cut in triangles, fried at 180C until puffed, tossed in salt and five spice, sweet chilli dip.
M: Chinatown, where Uncle Benny runs things
Duck pricked, dried overnight, rubbed with five spice and salt inside, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, glazed with honey and soy for the last 15. Pancakes, cucumber and hoisin.
caught on his own boat, for once
Whole snapper scored, stuffed with lemon and herbs, grilled over medium coals 10 minutes a side.
W: Leo talks too much, his fortune says so
Thin vanilla batter in circles, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded around a paper fortune while hot.
K: Cold lager in an esky on the deck.

s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, 3 chopped shiitake, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 tbsp soy. Spoon into 24 wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides leaving the top open and add a dot of grated carrot. Steam for 8 minutes.

s.note: Leo's back, and he will not stop talking
s.how: Cut 20 wonton wrappers into triangles. Fry at 180C in batches for about 30 seconds until puffed and golden. Drain and toss with salt and a pinch of five spice. Serve with sweet chilli sauce for dipping.

m.note: Chinatown, where Uncle Benny runs things
m.how: Prick a 2kg duck all over and dry uncovered in the fridge overnight. Rub inside with five spice and salt. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes, glazing with 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp soy for the last 15. Serve with 20 pancakes, cucumber, spring onion and hoisin.

w.note: Leo talks too much, his fortune says so
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with 100g sugar, then stir in 60g flour, 40g melted butter and a little vanilla. Spread 8cm circles on a lined tray and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Working fast, fold each around a paper fortune.

d.how: Fill an esky with a bag of ice and a little water. Bury eight 375ml bottles of lager for an hour. Hand them out on the back deck and drink them straight from the bottle.
